# TASK-156 — Document evidence diagrams through MCP

- **Status:** In progress — implemented, verification incomplete
- **Area:** Document conversation and diagrams (2026-10-01)

## Intent

MCP is a renderer, not a Markdown reasoning engine. Produce deterministic evidence maps from recorded answers and section labels, with no invented relationships. A user may request the current section or all missing diagrams; the configured renderer must be allowlisted and read-only. Each successful result becomes a reviewable proposal tied to its source revision. Report per-section failures, retain existing diagrams, and prevent duplicates for unchanged inputs. Accepted diagrams accompany generated specification, product and design documents. Never call external renderers for local-only projects. Deeper semantic diagrams and unattended refresh are separate follow-ups.
